operations.description: Configure the Podman container for service api when activated.
Use the existing PostgreSQL endpoint reference.
Bind service api to PostgreSQL resource primary-db.

prerequisites.description: Import the module on a NixOS host with Podman as its OCI backend.
Make image example.invalid/shop/api:fixture available for service api.
Supply SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME and SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD in /run/secrets/magic-infra/shop_dev/shop-db-credentials.env at runtime.

diagnostics.message: Datasource URL is provided as a runtime reference; ownership must be declared explicitly.
